system.moveDescription: You have two additional cozy activities; pick them from the list on your character sheet or write your own. Additionally, once per mystery, so long as you are engaged in one of your cozy activities, you can trigger the Cozy Move with a resident of Brindlewood Bay who is not a Maven. Finally, during the Cozy Move with another Maven, whichever Maven is doing their cozy activity can stumble on a Clue as normal OR clear another appropriate Condition.
